period.label: Month
period.notCalculated: Not calculated yet. Figures appear after the next calculation.

statement.title: Commission statement
statement.intro: Commission is earned when an invoice is paid, on the amount excluding VAT, at the rate in force that day.
statement.noEmployee: Your account is not linked to an employee record, so you have no statement. Open the team summary instead.
statement.empty: No commission lines in this month.
statement.rules: Returns within 90 days of collection, reversed allocations and bounced payments reduce the month they happen in. A closed month never changes.
statement.funnelHint: Commission is earned on the collected amount excluding VAT. Free (bonus) lines earn nothing; products without a rate earn 0 until the owner sets one.

team.title: Team commission
team.intro: Commission per employee for the month. Open a name to see the statement.
team.empty: No commission in this month for the employees you can see.

periods.title: Commission periods
periods.intro: Each month is recalculated every night and closes on day 6 of the next month. A closed month is final.
periods.closeHint: Closing runs the final calculation and freezes the month. Later returns and bounced payments go to the month they happen in.
periods.confirmClose: I checked the {month} statements and want to close the month.

adjust.title: Commission adjustments
adjust.intro: A bonus, clawback or correction for one employee and month. Each one needs approval before it counts.
adjust.amountPositive: A bonus must be a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
adjust.amountNegative: A clawback must be a negative amount with at most 2 decimals.
adjust.amountInvalid: Enter a non-zero amount with at most 2 decimals.
adjust.reasonHint: Shown on the employee's statement and to the approver.
adjust.noEmployees: There is no employee you can adjust.
adjust.noOpenMonth: There is no open month to adjust.

messages.pending: Sent for approval. It counts once approved.
messages.posted: The adjustment is on the statement.
messages.rateSet: The rate was saved. It applies from its start day.
messages.rateCleared: The rate stops from that day.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.VALIDATION: Some values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This month cannot be changed in its current state.
errors.PERIOD_CLOSED: This month is closed. Use an open month.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_ENDED: A month can be closed only after it has ended.
errors.PREVIOUS_PERIOD_OPEN: Close the earlier open month first.
errors.SELF_ADJUSTMENT: You cannot adjust your own commission.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This form was already used for another request. Reload the page.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is not reachable. Check the connection and try again.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED: This action needs a code from your authenticator app. Open My security (Account security), verify this session, then try again.
errors.DUPLICATE: A plan with this code already exists.
errors.COMMISSION_RULE_IMMUTABLE: A rate is never edited. Set a new rate from a date instead.
errors.COMMISSION_PLAN_IMMUTABLE: An active or retired plan cannot be changed this way.

plans.title: Commission plans and rates
plans.intro: Rates by brand, category or product, each from a date. Only the owner changes them; closed months never change.
plans.rateCount: {count, plural, =0 {no rate today} one {# rate today} other {# rates today}}
plans.assignedCount: {count, plural, =0 {no employee assigned} one {# employee assigned} other {# employees assigned}}
plans.rulesExplained: The most specific rate applies: product, then category, then brand, then the plan default. A change takes effect from its date; the earlier rate stays in the history.
plans.planDefault: Every product without a more specific rate
plans.newPlanHint: A new plan starts as a draft on collected cash. Set its rates, then activate it.
plans.codeHint: Letters, digits, - or _, for example STD-2027.
plans.name: Name
plans.activateHint: From the chosen day, collections earn at this plan's rates. The day cannot fall in a closed month.
plans.activeFromHint: Usually today or the first day of this month.
plans.assignReps: Assign every sales rep to this plan from that day (recommended)
plans.confirmActivate: I checked the rates of {code} and want to activate it.
plans.deactivateHint: The plan keeps applying to the days up to the last day, and to none after. Its assignments end that day.
plans.confirmDeactivate: I want {code} to end on that day.
plans.retiredReadOnly: This plan is retired. Its rates are history and cannot change.
plans.rulesEmpty: No rate applies today or later.
plans.rateHint: Choose what the rate is for, the rate and the day it starts. To stop a rate, tick "No rate from this day".
plans.defaultHint: Applies to every product that has no product, category or brand rate.
plans.targetRequired: Choose the brand, category or product.
plans.rateInvalid: Enter a rate from 0 to 100 with at most 2 decimals.
plans.effectiveFromHint: It cannot start in a closed month.
plans.unratedHint: These earn 0 commission until a rate covers them (for example bone grafts and membranes).
plans.unratedEmpty: Every product has a rate today.
plans.setBrandRate: Set a rate for this brand
